categories.main_business_segments: Sinosteel Luonai Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and service of mid-to-high-end refractory materials. Its product portfolio includes eight series with over 200 varieties, such as shaped and unshaped refractory products, widely used in steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemical, ceramics, cement, glass, power, environmental protection, and defense industries. The company also provides engineering design, consulting, industrial furnace design, manufacturing, installation, and technical training services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies including high-temperature energy-saving and environmentally friendly refractory materials, metallurgical functional refractory materials with enhanced service performance, high-performance silicon carbide materials, and advanced ceramic flow control devices for thin slab continuous casting. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as nano-technology, composite ceramic technology, gradient design, and high-temperature vacuum sintering. The company also integrates technology development with production lines and focuses on innovation in green, long-life, and functional refractory materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from the steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, petrochemical, ceramics, glass, power, environmental protection, and defense sectors. Major clients include large domestic and international steel groups such as China Baowu Steel Group and China Minmetals Group. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports to Europe, the Americas, and Asia, and has a strong presence in nickel iron rotary kiln refractory engineering globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Henan Province (Luoyang) and subsidiaries in Ningxia and other regions. It actively expands international markets including India, Russia, Indonesia, Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The main refractory material production regions in China include Henan, Liaoning, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Hebei, and Beijing, with Henan, Shandong, and Liaoning accounting for about 70% of national output.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinosteel Luonai operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production and supply of refractory materials essential for high-temperature industrial processes. It also provides downstream engineering, installation, and technical services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the refractory materials industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on green, energy-saving, long-life, and functional refractory materials. It invests heavily in R&D, with projects targeting advanced ceramics for steelmaking, gas turbines, gasification, and environmental applications. The firm aims to enhance its core competitiveness through breakthroughs in material science, process optimization, and digital transformation, aligning with national carbon neutrality goals and industry trends towards sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of refractory materials (shaped, unshaped, and prefabricated products), engineering and technical services, and sales of instruments and new materials. The company employs multiple sales models including direct sales, trade sales, ton-steel settlement mode (performance-based billing), and engineering contracting. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's refractory materials industry, recognized for its strong technological capabilities, comprehensive product range, and brand reputation. It competes with other domestic and international refractory manufacturers, benefiting from industry consolidation and government policies favoring large-scale, innovative enterprises. Its strategic partnerships with major steel groups and international market expansion strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.19 billion, a 12.91% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 59 million. Total assets stood at RMB 5.21 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.96 billion. Despite short-term profitability challenges due to market downturns in steel and building materials sectors, the company maintains significant scale and continues investing in R&D and capacity expansion to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinosteel Luonai emphasizes high-quality, innovative refractory materials with superior performance characteristics such as long service life, energy efficiency, environmental friendliness, and functional integration. Its products are tailored for demanding high-temperature industrial applications, supported by strong R&D and quality control systems. The company offers comprehensive solutions including engineering design and technical services, positioning itself as a trusted partner for high-temperature industrial customers seeking advanced, sustainable refractory solutions.
